why: survive-v1 WITH THE COLOUR FIXED. Same hypothesis and the same six cuts; v1's own pre-registered risk check refused it. It added nine white pips against the four its cuts removed — Baird, Wrath of God, Cleansing Nova and Settle the Wreckage are all double-white — on a list whose white had only just been brought to parity at 21 sources, and interaction_6 fell 0.795 to 0.675. The answers were in hand and could not be paid for, which is the exact defect the branch existed to fix, arriving through the mana instead of the board. THIS IS A DESIGN FIX, NOT A SECOND ROLL AT THE SAME DICE: the objective grades the branch's RISK rather than its reward, so tuning the list until the risk clears is the work, and the reward is still decided in Forge where none of it has been measured yet. Kept: Ghostly Prison (one white pip, the cheapest taxer), Wrath of God (the single best sweeper), Leyline of Anticipation. Replaced Baird, Cleansing Nova and Settle the Wreckage with answers that cost no white at all — Aetherize {3}{U} returns all ATTACKING creatures at instant speed, which is Settle the Wreckage in blue and is the flash plan; Evacuation {3}{U}{U} resets the whole board; Nevinyrral's Disk is a colourless sweeper that also answers the artifacts and enchantments giada-angels wins through. Three white pips added against four removed, so the branch is now white-NEGATIVE. All six are clean in Forge: no AI:RemoveDeck flag on any of them, and Oblivion Stone was rejected for carrying one.
